titles: Separate Stems to New Audio Tracks

description: Use Live's own commands, through its menus and keys, for what your other tools can't do: group or ungroup tracks, freeze, unfreeze or flatten a track, bounce a track or clip to audio without playing it (bounce_to_new_track, bounce_track_in_place), consolidate, convert an audio clip to MIDI (melody, harmony, drums), separate stems, slice to a MIDI track, save the Set (or collect all and save), save it as a new file (save_as with path), start a new Set (new_set) or open one (open_set with path), export audio or a MIDI clip. new_set and open_set replace the open Set: say what happens to its unsaved changes with save_current (ask the producer when they didn't say), and references from before are gone once it's open. Never make or edit .als files yourself: Live calls a Set it didn't write corrupt. Give the command and what it works on (track, tracks side by side, or clip): Kumi selects it in Live, presses the command, and says what changed. For anything else Live's menus or keys do, give menu (the item's titles, ["Create", "Insert Silence"]) or keys (["cmd+e"]). When Live opens a dialog, its words and buttons come back: answer presses one. Live comes to the front for a moment. Prefer your other tools whenever one does the job.

command.description: One of Live's commands Kumi knows

track.description: The track it works on (its reference from this turn, or its name)

tracks.description: Tracks side by side (to group them), first to last

clip.description: The clip it works on: its clipRef from this turn (a Session clip; for converting to MIDI, an audio clip in Session or Arrangement), or "selected" for the one the producer selected in Live

path.description: The Set's file, a full path: where save_as saves it (its folder must exist; .als is added), which Set open_set opens, or where save puts a Set never saved

save_current.description: For new_set and open_set when the open Set has unsaved changes: yes saves them first, no discards them, cancel keeps the Set open

menu.description: Any of Live's menu items by its titles, ["Edit", "Freeze Track"]

keys.description: Keys to press in Live, one combination each: "cmd+shift+r", "down"

answer.description: Press this button of the dialog Live has open (OK, Export, Cancel…)
